GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (19 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-620)
APO 500
19 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Revision of the Purchase Prices of Gold and Silver Payable by the Government.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No. 1307 (2.1) dated 27 December 1945, subject: “Revision of the Purchase Price of Gold and Silver Payable by Government”
2. Your request in paragraph 2 of subject memorandum to increase the purchase and or sale price of gold to \17 per gram and silver to ¥310 per kilogram is approved. It is directed that the bonus system used for the encouragement of the production of gold and silver be abolished effective this date.
3. Your request in paragraph 3 of subject memorandum is not approved. It is directed that no adjustment be made in the new rate without the prior approval of this Headuarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
